title: FunctionalityCandidate
description: One inert discovery result: an exact family definition with its provenance. Discovery never installs, persists, enables, or executes it.

alias.description: The alias the candidate would take if added; a suggestion, never authority.

detail.description: Optional family-owned structured presentation facts (for example a members preview's match counts and sample paths). Never credentials, never authority.

definition.description: The exact family definition, conforming to the family's definition schema.
